data.title: Energy Vault Announces Strategic Agreement to Deploy 1.25 GW of Integrated Power Infrastructure for Hyperscaler AI Data Center with Leading Power Generation EPC Deploying Caterpillar Gensets
data.description: In Westlake Village, California, Energy Vault Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: NRGV) recently disclosed a significant development. The company, known as a top player in sustainable energy infrastructure, revealed the signing of a key commercial deal. According to this agreement, Energy Vault will be providing battery energy storage systems (BESS), grid-forming power conversion systems, and AI infrastructure control software. This support is intended for an initial rollout that encompasses a substantial 1.25 gigawatts (GW) of integrated power infrastructure catering to hyperscaler AI data needs.
